rules.rationale: Halogen substitution adds polarizable nonpolar surface; halogen_mid covers 743 candidates, giving the surrogate usable support.
Extended aromatic pi systems supply nonpolar surface that partitions preferentially into octanol.
Dense heteroatoms raise hydrogen bonding and desolvation cost, suppressing measured logD.
Few polar atoms means weak hydration; consistent with the source H-bond-donor role mapped onto heteroatom count.

skills.hypothesis: Domain-knowledge prior: lipophilicity tracks nonpolar surface (halogen, aromatic) minus polar hydration burden (heteroatoms). Fails if this pool's logD variance is dominated by ionization state or scaffold size rather than composition.

rules.rationale: Ring role carried the largest source transfer weight (0.758); fused hydrophobic rings favor octanol partitioning.
Source: smiles_long lowered solubility (-11.46); logD roughly opposes logS, so bulk should raise lipophilicity.
Source: smiles_short raised solubility (+6.89); compact molecules are usually less lipophilic.
Counter-hypothesis: the low-confidence (0.224) length transfer likely saturates or inverts for very long, solubilizing-group-rich chains.

skills.hypothesis: Transfers ESOL ring and length effects with reversed sign under logD/logS anti-correlation, while damping the extreme-length tail. Fails if lipophilicity here is composition-driven rather than size-driven.

state.lesson: Source evidence comes from a different endpoint with low per-field confidence, so sign-reversed transfer stays a hypothesis; mechanistic partitioning descriptors with adequate bin support are the safer deployment prior.
state.revision_summary: Replaced the sparse halogen_high rule (98 candidates) with halogen_mid (743) to give the surrogate real support, and consolidated heteroatom evidence into a symmetric high-penalty/low-bonus pair. Moved the length counterweight into the transfer skill so the two skills are cleanly separated: one composition-driven domain prior, one reversed-solubility size/ring transfer with a damped very_long tail. Deployed the composition-driven skill with decaying semantic mass and a slightly UCB-leaning anchor.
